vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: presales-cloud-architect
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle consists of a metadata file and a markdown instruction set (skill.md) designed to guide an AI agent in generating B2B cloud architecture proposals. It leverages standard web search capabilities to gather public information about target companies and provides a structured template for professional reporting. There is no executable code, no evidence of data exfiltration, and no malicious prompt injection intended to subvert the agent's safety or privacy.

llm.summary: This instruction-only presales cloud-architect skill is internally consistent with its stated purpose and requests no extra credentials or installs; its main runtime behavior is web-searching public information and producing a presales architecture brief.

dimensions.detail: Name and description match the SKILL.md: the skill is a presales cloud-architecture brief generator that asks the agent to gather public information via network search and produce a structured proposal. It requests no unrelated binaries, env vars, or config paths — proportional to its stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions explicitly require the agent to use its '联网搜索能力' (internet search) to fetch latest public info and to distinguish facts vs reasonable inferences. The scope stays within presales research and writing (no instructions to read local files, system credentials, or report to third‑party endpoints). Note: the skill is open-ended about which public sources to use; if the runtime environment lacks internet access the agent must mark '信息不足'.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only skill. This is lowest-risk for disk persistence or arbitrary code execution.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. That is proportionate for a public-information research and writing task.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false, user-invocable true, and model invocation is allowed (defaults). The skill does not request persistent installation, nor does it request modification of other skills or system settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is largely coherent and low-risk because it's instruction-only and asks only for public web research and written output. Before installing or using it, consider: (1) confirm whether your agent runtime permits outbound web access — if not, results may be incomplete or the agent should return '信息不足'; (2) avoid pasting sensitive customer secrets or full internal config into the input — the skill expects customer-provided context but doesn't need credentials; (3) verify any technical claims the skill generates (cost savings, compliance statements, RTO/RPO numbers) against your engineering team and real measurements rather than taking them at face value; (4) ensure use complies with your data-handling policies when feeding customer PII into the skill; and (5) if you expect the skill to access private cloud accounts for deep analysis, require explicit, audited credentials rather than relying on this instruction-only skill. Overall this looks consistent with its stated purpose.
